An '''exposure suit''' was an article of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] readily available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was usually found for sale in large [[City/Legends|cities]] and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]. General exposure suits retailed for three hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], while specialist arid environment suits sold for four hundred credits.<ref name="SWS" />
